KPlugin.Name: CyberKDE Popups
KPlugin.Description: Plasma popups revealed from their trigger, menus and tooltips with a short slide, notifications entering from the edge (CyberKDE). Replaces Fading and Sliding Popups.
KPlugin.Description[pt_BR]: Popups do Plasma revelados a partir do acionador, menus e dicas com deslize curto, notificações entrando pela borda. Substitui Fading popups e Sliding popups.
